description.value: A remote wilderness campsite at Bare Loon Lake in northern BC or Yukon; no facilities are confirmed and the source page was unavailable, so treat this as a self-sufficient backcountry stop with uncertain access.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM-linked URL (pc.gc.ca/lhn-nhs/yt/chilkoot/visit/activ1b_m/activ1b_m8.aspx) returned a 404 error — Parks Canada has reorganized its site and this page no longer exists. The fetched subpages are all generic Parks Canada portal pages with no information specific to Bare Loon Lake. All amenity fields must therefore be null, derived only from OSM tags which contain no amenity detail beyond operator=Parks Canada and tourism=camp_site. Notably, the coordinates (59.7962184, -135.0363788) and the URL path (/yt/chilkoot/) place this campsite on the Chilkoot Trail in Yukon Territory, not British Columbia.
